title: Dialpad Call Center Alternatives for Hotels (2026)
summary: Dialpad call center alternatives for hotels in 2026: hotel phone system vs Dialpad on porting, routing, SMS, VoiceAI, and PMS write-back.
body_markdown:
*Written by Punn Kam, ex-Google AI engineer and Y Combinator repeat founder. He is the co-founder of Conduit, an AI agent platform purpose-built for hospitality, supporting 300+ hospitality brands in over 120 countries. Last updated September 4, 2026.*


Hotels using Dialpad as a call center still need queues, call groups, and a 20-second SLA at the front desk. Conduit staffs that line like a contact center: simultaneous or longest-idle groups, a queue report with a 20s SLA, and voice metered in credits from a published package allowance (40 to 100 credits by package, 2,000 on the Startup plan).


## What does a hotel call center need that Dialpad does not?


Dialpad is a general business call center. Hotels that keep it as the property phone still need to staff the front desk like a contact center: queues, call groups that ring simultaneous or longest idle, and a queue report with a 20-second SLA. Guest-aware routing and SMS still matter, but this page is the call-center cut of Dialpad for hotels, not another seat-minimum roundup.


The companion list of hotel phone plus guest-inbox substitutes is[6 Best Dialpad Alternatives for Hotels (2026)](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/dialpad-alternatives) .


## How do hotel call-center alternatives compare to Dialpad?

Aircall belongs here as a Dialpad-class PBX, not as the hero. Its published constraint is a three-licence floor. That is a seat problem, not a guest-queue problem.


## How do Conduit call groups and the 20s queue SLA work?


Treat the front desk like a small contact center. Put agents in a call group. Ring everyone at once (simultaneous) or the person who has been idle longest. The queue report is built around a 20-second SLA, so you can see whether the property line is answering like a staffed desk or dumping to voicemail.


That is different from Dialpad's general contact-center routing, which is built for a sales or support floor, not a hotel front office with occupancy-driven volume.


## How are Conduit voice credits billed vs Dialpad conversation credits?


Conduit and Dialpad meter AI on different units, so the two bills do not compare line for line. Conduit publishes a credit allowance per package, 40, 60, 80 or 100 credits depending on the package and 2,000 on the Startup plan, and does not publish a per-minute burn rate. Dialpad describes conversation-based pricing for its AI, where credits are consumed when the AI delivers value.


Ask both vendors the same question before signing: what exactly consumes a credit. Then compare a month of occupancy against a month of conversations, not a seat count.


## Should a hotel keep Dialpad and add a guest messaging tool?


Only if you accept two systems of record. The front desk will still take reservation changes on Dialpad, then re-type them into the PMS, while SMS lives somewhere else. The usual failure is a guest who called, then texted, and got two answers. If you keep Dialpad, write a hard rule for what the AI is allowed to finish.


Guest-messaging shortlists sit at[best hotel guest messaging 2026](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-hotel-guest-messaging-2026) ,[Canary vs HiJiffy](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/canary-vs-hijiffy) , and[HelloShift vs Canary](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/helloshift-vs-canary) .


## Who should stay on Dialpad as the hotel call center?


Groups whose phone team is a corporate contact center that happens to take hotel overflow, with CRM workflows already in Dialpad Support or Sell. Stay if the agent is coached like a sales floor and guests are a minority of callers.


Leave if the published number is the front desk. Then the reservation is the system of record, and a general call center will keep handing completed conversations to people unless you add hotel queues, call groups, and a 20-second SLA.


## FAQ


### What does a hotel call center need that Dialpad does not?


Queues, call groups that ring simultaneous or longest idle, a queue report with a 20-second SLA, and a path to the reservation. Dialpad covers the general contact-center half.


### How do hotel call-center alternatives compare to Dialpad?


Dialpad, Aircall, RingCentral, and Quo are business phone systems. Conduit is a hotel call center on the property line: call groups, 20s SLA queue report, VoiceAI, PMS write-back. Aircall's extra constraint is a three-licence minimum.


### How do Conduit call groups and the 20s queue SLA work?


Agents sit in a call group. Ring simultaneous or longest idle. The queue report uses a 20-second SLA so the front desk is staffed like a contact center, not a missed-call list.


### How are Conduit voice credits billed vs Dialpad conversation credits?


Conduit publishes a credit allowance per package, 40 to 100 credits by package and 2,000 on the Startup plan, and does not publish a per-minute rate. Dialpad meters AI on conversations. Those are different units, so compare a month of usage rather than seat counts.


### Should a hotel keep Dialpad and add a guest messaging tool?


Avoid two guest records. A call on Dialpad and a text in another inbox is how guests get conflicting answers. Keep Dialpad only with a written rule for what the AI may complete.


### Who should stay on Dialpad as the hotel call center?


Corporate contact centers that already live in Dialpad Support or Sell, where hotel guests are overflow. Front-desk numbers belong on a hotel call center with queues and a 20s SLA.


### Can Conduit replace Dialpad as the hotel call center?


For the property line, yes if you treat the desk like a contact center: call groups, 20s SLA, VoiceAI. Watch-out: hospitality vertical only, inbound WhatsApp is voice-only, and you still project-plan the number port.
